title: I'm back. Going to give it another go.

posts.author: MoltresRider
posts.body:
I fled the scene like, god it must have been seven or eight months ago, due to drama. Well, I am deciding that another chance is in order.
One thing that I did not like with my time here before was that everybody was saying I was being aggressive when I was not. Sure, I was aggressive sometimes, but at least half of those I actually was not aggressive or at least not intending to be aggressive. And that is what made me ditch the forums in the first place.
What made me decide to give it another go is that the help that I
did
receive on here was significant and very helpful. While I did not show appreciation all the time, deep down inside, everything you helped me resolve was very much appreciated.
It has been quite some time now, and I have had plenty of time to think about it and grow, and I feel it is time that I should give the forums another chance as long as you all are willing to give me another chance. I will make one request though, please go easy on me. Most of the time that I "sound" aggressive, I am not trying to be aggressive, unless I sound really aggressive. Truth be told, I am bad with social skills, and I am diagnosed with Asperger's, Adult ADHD, and Anxiety Disorder, and the ADHD and the Anxiety Disorder is a horrible mix and that is why I can appear to be aggressive when I am not being aggressive. Unless I am saying "you lied", "that is false", or anything along those natures (which I will admit that I have said) or typing in all caps, 9 times out of 10, I am not trying to be aggressive
I have also grown since I left, and I have been far less aggressive on other websites, including Reddit, and I plan to carry that same attitude here.
I will do my best to remain non-aggressive and express more appreciation for the help I received here rather than act like it is assumed.
In fact, some of the folks here, who thought I was mean to them are actually some of my favorite members.
So, I was wondering if we can start over with a clean slate moving forward, and as long as I remain non-aggressive, I ask that we act like my past did not happen. If I am aggressive again, then you are free to judge me on it, but all I am asking is to put your distaste for me aside and start over fresh. It is up to you if you are willing to agree with this, as there is no obligation.
PS: I have gotten a bit more advanced with RPG Maker VX Ace having to figure stuff out on my own these last many months, so asking questions, finding solutions will likely be smoother. If only you knew what advanced things I put in Moltres Rider's RPG since last time. It is 140 hours and counting now, but I am on the second to final stretch.

This is a text-based forum. All that anyone here can go off of is what you type in your posts.
If you use insulting language or don't thank people, then that's what's on the screen - if you "intended" something else, that's generally irrelevant.
As far as the second bit...there are thousands of people registered here. It isn't anyone's responsibility to track other people's mental conditions and modify how they respond to each individual poster.
Rather, it is each individual's responsibility to be aware of their own conditions and present themselves accordingly - even if that means you have a friend who helps you by reading through what you have to say before you post. Just like in the rest of the world, you're responsible for how you interact with society, including getting whatever methods of help you need to achieve that.
Good luck with your projects and your interactions.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body: A lot of people leave these forums for one reason or another. Users who were once daily posters left. You don't need to justify a reason to stay or leave.
